Financial Analyst
Cobalt Rivers Financial Corp.
Charlotte, NC

Cobalt Rivers Financial Corp. is a regional credit union serving 200,000 members. The FP&A team builds the budget, tracks results against it, and explains the variance to leadership.

What you bring
- 2+ years in financial planning and analysis
- Financial modeling and forecasting in Excel
- Strong PowerPoint skills for board materials
- Experience with SQL Server or another relational database
- Stakeholder management with department heads

A plus
- Salesforce reporting
- VBA macros
- Power Query

On-site, with one remote day a week after training.
